title: Date Extension Notice for the post of Deputy Registrar/ Deputy Controller of Examinations

source.name: University of Kashmir, Jammu and Kashmir

text:
KEY LINES:
Examinations advertised vide Advertisement Notice No. 02 of 2024
dated: 28-10-2024 has been extended from 12.12.2024 up to & including
19.12.2024.
office of the Recruitment Section upto 23.12.2024.
No. KU/Rect/Advt/24

FULL TEXT:
University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade A+
University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar 190006, Kashmir.
EXTENSION NOTICE
It is notified for the information of all the concerned that the date for submission of
online application forms for the post of Deputy Registrar/Deputy Controller of
Examinations advertised vide Advertisement Notice No. 02 of 2024
dated: 28-10-2024 has been extended from 12.12.2024 up to & including
19.12.2024.
Further, the hard copies of the said application forms shall be deposited in the
office of the Recruitment Section upto 23.12.2024.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
Recruitment
No. KU/Rect/Advt/24
Dated: December 11, 2024
